rules: Carry applicable IDs into the current project requirements registry. Keep one authority.
Each ID needs scope, owner, artifact, actual evidence, review and closure. Missing evidence remains pending or blocked.
ID coverage does not prove domain quality. Conditional capabilities do not become mandatory.

items.title: Complete concept and technical handoff
items.acceptance: The C1/T package covers all active systems, exceptions, catalogs, algorithms, resources, and reconstruction by a fresh receiver without inventing the design.
items.negative_case: A handoff with hidden behavioral TBDs fails.

items.title: Deep capability systems
items.acceptance: Cover families, compatibility, specializations, functional differences, scenarios and exact T rules.
items.negative_case: Three percentage upgrades do not replace a meaningful progression space.

items.title: Monetization across the metagame
items.acceptance: Compare alternatives, the free/no-offer baseline, paid portfolio, partial ownership and the full purchase lifecycle.
items.negative_case: One skin or a direct sale of an earned item does not establish a viable model.

items.title: First-class production systems
items.acceptance: Cover 20 system applicability and ownership records, interactions with named reads or changes, and evidence due.
items.negative_case: An all-to-all graph or headings alone cannot satisfy coverage.

items.title: World and situation composition
items.acceptance: Authored vocabulary, constraints, progression envelope, novelty signatures, bounded repair/fallback
items.negative_case: Seed counts or 30 shuffled routes do not prove novelty.

items.title: Complete agents and challenges
items.acceptance: Cover perception, knowledge, actions, coordination, weaknesses, bosses, and recovery as applicable.
items.negative_case: Magical knowledge and variants distinguished only by HP fail.

items.title: Causal world responsiveness
items.acceptance: Visible changes need a cause, simulation boundary, persistence and possible consequences.
items.negative_case: Random decoration does not establish a reactive world.

items.title: Comfortable, distinctive interaction
items.acceptance: Intent/action/gesture/presentation, peak two-thumb/cancel/accessibility traces
items.negative_case: A button for every action or a hidden ambiguous gesture does not solve interaction.

items.title: maturity
items.acceptance: Distinguish C0, C1 and T. Complete candidates require C1.
items.negative_case: C0 cannot be accepted-concept.

items.title: system_register
items.acceptance: Record applicability for the 20 systems, rationale, owner and consumer, data, rules, budget and proof.
items.negative_case: An unavailable tool does not make a system N/A.

items.title: behavior_math
items.acceptance: Define types, units, ranges, order, capture, time, RNG and fixtures.
items.negative_case: A formula alone omits rounding, zero and overflow boundaries.

items.title: catalog_progression
items.acceptance: Cover the C1 family space and all T launch data and generator constraints.
items.negative_case: Item count does not establish decision diversity.

items.title: world
items.acceptance: Cover macrostructure, route, spaces, encounters, consequences and novelty.
items.negative_case: Distinct seeds with the same strategy do not establish variety.

items.title: lore
items.acceptance: Cover canon, knowledge, quests, dialogue and causal reactions with state authority.
items.negative_case: An NPC cannot know a fact it has not learned.

items.title: input
items.acceptance: Separate intent, action, gesture and presentation, and inspect actual traces.
items.negative_case: Cancel or suspend must not leave an attack active or carry touch into a purchase.

items.title: journey
items.acceptance: Cover product states, learning, return, completion and errors.
items.negative_case: A complete collection does not break rewards.

items.title: creative
items.acceptance: Track source, export, import and scene lineage for every asset, audio and haptic state.
items.negative_case: PNG does not establish a rig, stems or native runtime behavior.

items.title: commerce
items.acceptance: Cover complete offers and metagame, free and paid options, time, variance and dominance.
items.negative_case: Partial ownership, retry or refund must not duplicate a grant.

items.title: handoff
items.acceptance: A fresh recipient reproduces scenarios from pinned documents and data.
items.negative_case: Chat history cannot be a hidden prerequisite.

items.title: evidence
items.acceptance: Give due scope and independent actor; distinguish semantic, runtime, native, device and human evidence.
items.negative_case: A quality score or extension does not establish functionality.

items.title: impact
items.acceptance: Apply targeted transitive invalidation across real semantic links.
items.negative_case: Grip changes reopen route, input and tire economy checks, not the studio master.

items.title: migration
items.acceptance: Preserve 3.0 originals, IDs, decisions and proof in history and identify new gaps.
items.negative_case: Earlier acceptance cannot close the current gate.

items.title: Cause of failure and recovery cost
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: Builds on P1 §§7.1,11: pre-event information → available responses → action → consequence → lost/retained state → next useful step. Distinguish missing knowledge, execution error and technical defects. Deliver a failure/recovery matrix for concepts, preproduction, build and QA. Check that the player sees a relevant failure cause and another available step, and retry cannot softlock. Low to moderate cost. No required explanation screen for each death.

items.title: Commitment and irreversible boundaries
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5,10–12: define preview, commit, actual application, irreversible boundary and recovery for crafting, dismantling, routes, respec, story choices and exits. Deliver a commitment table in the state atlas for preproduction, UX, build and QA. Back, double-tap and cancel on either side of the boundary cannot double-charge or falsely confirm. Low to moderate cost; no mandatory modal or undo on every click.

items.title: Concurrent cues and attention budget
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §11.4: define which cues appear together, wait, aggregate or mute. Deliver an attention matrix and peak scene for experience, creative, assets, build and QA. Danger must stay readable alongside reward, objective and critical-resource cues on the weaker profile and with audio disabled. A delayed cue must not look current. Moderate cost. XAG supports multiple channels; the scheduler is our adaptation [S11].

items.title: Resolve competing camera requests
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §10: define priority for aim, traversal, interaction, boss and transition; ownership, release, return, and protection against oscillation. Deliver camera policy and traces to experience, preproduction, build and QA. Simultaneous aim, camera zone and boss intro must not jump or unexpectedly reverse touch direction. Low to moderate cost for games with those modes.

items.title: Multidimensional challenge profile
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§7–8: separate accuracy, reaction time, concurrency, information and resource pressure, and error cost. Deliver challenge profiles and progression envelope for systems, world, experience and QA. The generator should stress the intended decision instead of randomly increasing every dimension. Low to moderate cost. No hidden DDA. XAG108 supports distinguishing challenge types; it does not set the parameters [S11].

items.title: Assist semantics and comparable outcomes
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §10.5: for each assist define intervention, decisions retained, rule or timing changes, toggling, save and scoring scope. Deliver an assist matrix for preproduction, build, QA and release. Auto-aim, auto-throttle and slow mode must not reset spending or duplicate grants; show competition rules before participation. Moderate cost; do not universally remove rewards for accessibility.

items.title: Diagnose learning mistakes
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §11.2: distinguish missed affordance, unclear rule, unknown input, recognition failure, timing mistake and intentional exploration. Deliver an evidence-to-remediation table for learning, preproduction, build and human QA. A wrong swipe does not restart a tactical lecture, and a valid alternative strategy does not count as an error. Low to moderate cost; do not classify player psychology.

items.title: Restore the player's working context
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§7,11: retain accessible reminders of the current aim, unfinished intent, loadout and material changes. Deliver a reorientation contract for UX, progression, narrative, build and live operations. After a real break, a participant finds a useful step without replaying the tutorial; exploration hints need not expose the answer. Low to moderate cost. Technical saves and human memory have distinct checks.

items.title: Capability and opportunity to use it
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§7–8: map catalog families to actual opportunities in campaign and generated play. Deliver a capability×opportunity matrix and session report for systems, world, progression and QA. Specializations have useful opportunities after unlock; generation does not filter them all out and rewards arrive before the last viable use. Moderate cost. A low pick rate does not alone prove an item is weak.

items.title: Sequence mechanic exposure and return
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§8,11: introduce, practice safely, transfer, combine and reinterpret mechanics while tracking opportunities. Deliver the exposure graph to learning, world, preproduction and QA. Different routes prepare for a critical combined challenge; a long-unused action does not first reappear in the costliest moment without alternatives. Moderate cost; no forced linear school for all players.

items.title: Semantic interaction vocabulary
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §11: multiple cues preserve meanings such as grabbable, dangerous, action prepared and resource missing across biomes and appearances. Deliver invariant and variant examples to creative, experience, assets and QA. New art must not change learned surface or silhouette meaning; cues remain readable without one exclusive color. Low to moderate cost; keep each game's artistic language.

items.title: Complete localization contract
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: Unifies GQ12/E10; P1 §§5,11. Cover string IDs and context, plural/select/placeholders, terminology, units, prices, glyphs, fonts and licenses, shaping, text scale, RTL and subtitles as applicable. Deliver localization state matrix to assets, UX, build, QA and release. Long text cannot hide price or cancel; language change preserves IDs, save and formulas. Pseudolocalization does not replace actual script checks. Cost depends on language scope [S12].

items.title: Canonical contact timing
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§6,11: specify intent, startup, active, recovery, buffer and cancel on one timeline with simulation, rendering and audio domains. Deliver traces to systems, assets, build and QA. Hit stop, a slow effect or dropped render frame cannot repeat damage or change collisions or paid actions unless required by the rules. Moderate cost; verify differing refresh and load profiles.

items.title: States after content exhaustion
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§7,12: define outcomes for every unlock, max upgrade, completed collection, ending and excess resource. Deliver completion profile to progression, economy, world, build, QA and live operations. Full collections preserve reward, store and UI behavior; decide the fate of duplicates; do not imply absent endgame content. Low to moderate cost; an authored game may end.

items.title: Session duration and voluntary exit
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5,11: cover short, usual and long sessions, minimum useful activity, pause and exit, unfinished goals and recovery. Deliver boundary map to concepts, experience, progression, build and QA. A phone interruption is not abandonment unless the rules say so. A short visit has a useful action. Low to moderate cost; durations depend on genre.

items.title: Production scenario lab
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §14: in dev or test reproduce fixture, seed, loadout, locale and input profiles; disable a channel; compare config and stress scenes. Deliver scoped lab to build, tools, authors and QA. Reproduce a difficult defect without hours of replay; keep test menus and injection out of production. Moderate cost. Start with highest risk scenes.

items.title: Meaningful cooperative play where applicable
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §4/F: define roles, information, contribution, skill variance, AFK, disconnect/rejoin, irreversible actions and exit rights. Deliver contribution and recovery contract to concepts, preproduction, networking, UX and QA. Experts cannot take every meaningful action, reconnects cannot duplicate rewards, and the advertised mode works without required voice. High cost; no automatic multiplayer or backend.

items.title: Voluntary sharing and authorship where applicable
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 system 20 (§4.3): a build, creative result, solution or skilled moment should make sense outside the game. Deliver a sharing hypothesis and prototype to concepts, creative, build, QA and live operations. Players choose to share, spectators understand, and exports do not falsify play or expose excess data. Low research cost, moderate or high feature cost. No promise of virality.

items.title: Native adapter conformance probe
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§4–5,13: test actual operations, versions, prerequisites, threading, cancellation, errors, accounts and fallback in a small native scene before committing production. Deliver adapter contract and evidence to studio, preproduction, build and QA. Release minification and signing must preserve required cloud, IAP or haptic callbacks after debug success. Moderate per adapter; missing environment leaves proof pending.

items.title: Device feature capability matrix
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§3,5: bind features to hardware, API, renderer and plugin; detection, fallback and check. Deliver support matrix to concepts, build, QA and release. A supported OS with unsupported GPU path does not break the screen. A compliant fallback preserves information and rules. Low to moderate cost. OS version alone does not prove coverage.

items.title: Coherent activation of content, config and catalog
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5,13–14: pin epoch, hashes, dependency closure, client and schema compatibility, staging and atomic activation. Deliver activation manifest and state machine to build, QA, release and live operations. A new recipe stays inactive without its item/content; a partial download preserves the prior coherent set. Moderate cost. Runtime delivery is conditional; packaged games verify export integrity.

items.title: Exact base for incremental patches where applicable
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§11,17: preserve shipped base pack bytes, index, hash and patch chain instead of assuming a repeat export is identical. Deliver patch-base registry to build, release and QA. Reject a mismatched base before activation. Verify an authorized full fallback and recovery after interruption. Low storage and check cost; a launcher is not mandatory.

items.title: Cold first use
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5.4,13: measure cold install/cache/driver path, warm run and first shader, effect, animation, audio or load separately. Deliver first-use map and traces to assets, build and QA. First boss attack or shop opening must not reveal unacceptable hitching hidden by warm runs. Moderate cost; selective precompile depends on the pinned renderer and platform [S13].

items.title: Stable adaptive quality when selected
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§3,13: define allowed action order, thresholds, hysteresis, cooldown and recovery; separate decoration from gameplay. Deliver quality matrix and traces to technical art, build and QA. Quality should not oscillate near heat limits or remove hazard cues; keep hitboxes, physics and item value. Moderate cost; changes to the 60 FPS or visual target require an agreed support policy.

items.title: Transition peak memory and resource ownership
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §5: map residency, owner, lifetime and unload; overlap between outgoing and incoming scenes, decoding and UI buffers, and bounded concurrency. Deliver memory traces to assets, build and QA. Repeated transitions do not leak memory or hold every scene at the peak. File size is not runtime RAM or VRAM. Moderate cost; measure target profiles.

items.title: Automatic check after asset import
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §11.3: check dimensions, color, alpha, scale, pivot, compression, loops, clips, contact markers, collision and audio fields as applicable. Deliver import lint with resource IDs to assets, build and QA. A correct filename cannot hide a wrong axis or missing contact marker. Moderate cost; technical lint does not judge craft.

items.title: Verifiable authoring round-trip and semantic diff
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 system 18 (§4.3): canonical edit → semantic validation → preview → compare or revert. Deliver authoring workflow to preproduction, build, content and QA. Another author can add a valid module, lesson or variant without rewriting scattered formulas, and receives a reason for invalid dependencies. Moderate cost; reuse a sufficient editor or table workflow.

items.title: Bounded reproducible diagnostics
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §14: bind build, config, catalog, seed, input, minimal permitted state, expected, actual and causal log with privacy and retention. Deliver a repro capsule to build, QA and support. Reproduce in a pinned compatible environment without leaking secrets, tokens or private saves to a public issue. Moderate cost; report nondeterminism without promising universal replay.

items.title: Runtime causal inspector and reason codes
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§6,14: explain why an action, item, route, offer or AI decision was allowed, rejected or changed. Deliver a bounded inspector to systems, build and QA. `invalid loadout` gives the exact requirement or conflict and revision. Designers identify the reason without reading all runtime code. Low to moderate cost. Player explanations stay clear; logs protect hidden knowledge.

items.title: Match crash symbols to the exact build
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §13: bind binary and build IDs, dSYM and native symbols, stripping and obfuscation maps, and available crash artifacts. Deliver symbol manifest and staging crash proof to build, QA, release and live operations. A control crash resolves to correct functions and lines of this build, and mismatched UUIDs are rejected. Low to moderate cost; no required paid crash service [S14].

items.title: Transitive SDK and dependency provenance
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§3,17: pin versions, locks, sources, license, platform, privacy, cost, binaries and transitive dependencies including plugins. Deliver provenance diff to studio, build, QA and release. Detect added trackers, permissions or OS minimums before export; do not transfer old proof. Low to moderate cost without unnecessary services.

items.title: Observed data flows and consent states
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 systems 17–20 (§4.3): identify data leaving the device for guest, offline, opt-out, cloud and consent states; cover retention, deletion and minimal diagnostics. Deliver egress matrix and runtime test to build, QA, release and live operations. Turning analytics off prevents unwanted SDK upload; no token or complete save in logs. Moderate cost depends on actual SDKs and markets. Verify observed traffic.

items.title: Trust boundary for downloaded data when used
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5,17: define authenticated origin as needed, size, schema and types, hashes, compatibility, safe parsing, data/code separation and staged activation. Deliver import contract to preproduction, build, QA and release. Invalid manifest, oversized input and serialized objects cannot execute code or replace a valid copy. Moderate cost. No default downloads; apply the rule to cloud saves.

items.title: External dependency failure budget
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §13, system 20 (§4.3), decision F: define deadline, bounded retries and backoff, cancellation, identity, unknown outcome, reconciliation and fallback. Deliver dependency failure budget to preproduction, build, QA and live operations. No-fill, store or cloud timeout cannot freeze local play or double-grant. Late callbacks cannot target another profile. Moderate cost only when external dependencies exist.

items.title: Service replacement or retirement where applicable
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 system 20 (§4.3): define progress, access, durable rights, network modes, export, migration, support and account costs during outage or retirement. Deliver rehearsed service-loss path to director, preproduction, release, live operations and QA. Old clients avoid infinite login and preserve rights as declared. Moderate to high cost; no automatic perpetual server commitment.

items.title: Observed content production throughput
items.applies_when: Domain applicability under D1; cooperative play, sharing, patches, adaptive quality and service retirement are conditional.
items.acceptance_and_negative_case: P1 §§5,16: take one representative variant, enemy, module or audio event from intent to source, export, import, integration and QA. Measure time, cost and repair for studio, director, assets, build and QA. Show a feasible catalog and cadence. A bottleneck leads to a reviewed change in workflow or scope instead of silent quality loss. Moderate probe cost.

items.title: Opponents, NPCs and bosses
items.acceptance: Cover body, properties, perception, knowledge, decisions, actions, counterplay and fairness, boss phases, reset, save, performance and distinct player decisions.
items.negative_case: A plugin or schema does not prove required operations, restore or native callbacks.

items.title: Complete persistence and continuation
items.acceptance: Catalog all mutable fields by durable, reconstructible, ephemeral, cache or secret. Cover atomic local recovery, cloud auth and conflicts, migration, grants, deletion, clocks, RNG and identity.
items.negative_case: A plugin or schema does not prove required operations, restore or native callbacks.

items.title: Damage resolution
items.acceptance: Intent/contact/eligibility/channels/modifiers/resources/status/lifecycle; units/order/round/capture/RNG/dedup/bounded cascade/golden trace
items.negative_case: Replay or multiple hurtboxes do not duplicate damage.

items.title: Physics and crashes
items.acceptance: Solver-bound timestep/units/contact facts; angular relative motion; impulse/energy interpretation separate from damage; CCD/ownership/topology/debris
items.negative_case: Raw impulse is not automatically HP or real injury.

items.title: Death, failure and recovery
items.acceptance: Use applicable alive, downed, disabled, dead, despawn and respawn states. Cover simultaneous victory, death, resources, grants, commit and resume.
items.negative_case: Cloud or disk acknowledgement must not block immediate normal combat feedback.

items.title: Production capability proof per operation beyond native SDK probe D1Q19
items.acceptance: A flattened PNG cannot satisfy a required editable layer stack or rig.

items.title: Executable recipe with a consumer beyond authoring round-trip Q27
items.acceptance: A new worker finds preset, source, exports and checks the result without chat history.

items.title: Semantic obligations across transformations beyond import lint Q26
items.acceptance: A valid mesh or clip with different scale or contact time fails integration.

items.title: Production coverage beyond sample throughput Q36
items.acceptance: Every required death, cancel, locale and contact state has a feasible production route.

items.title: Actual production attempts separate from gameplay reproduction Q28
items.acceptance: A timeout does not repeat a completed paid generation or remote build.

items.title: Admit work against accepted inputs, interfaces, resources and competency
items.acceptance: Concurrent writers for a shared export, device or other resource cannot corrupt the result.

items.title: Semantic cache key and freshness proofs
items.acceptance: An exporter or model change invalidates dependent outputs while preserving the accepted original.

items.title: Assembly obligations in a representative slice
items.acceptance: Separate approved animation and audio cannot hide incorrect in-scene contact.

items.title: Causal diagnosis and repair budget
items.acceptance: Changing no variable and repeating a prompt cannot create missing rig capability.

items.title: Host bridge with pinned inputs and return validation
items.acceptance: A receipt for an old Android build does not prove a current iOS claim.

items.title: Descriptor, schema, catalog, argument binding and parameter consumption
items.acceptance: An unsupported or silently ignored material parameter does not satisfy a requirement.
